commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot from Duke to Ruby
commitResults.messageBody: Align the Java entry point and user documentation with the Ruby product name, and replace the old Duke output with the selected Big Money-ne startup banner.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add initial Ruby greeting and farewell
commitResults.messageBody: Print the chatbot banner, introduction, prompt, separators, and closing message so the starter application greets the user and exits as required.
Add a command-reading loop and extract terminal formatting into Ui so Ruby echoes complete input lines, prints a farewell for bye, and exits cleanly.
Store up to 100 task descriptions, acknowledge newly added tasks, and display the current tasks with one-based numbering while keeping the chatbot active until bye.
Represent tasks with completion state, parse one-based mark and unmark commands, and display status icons in numbered task listings and confirmations.
